verdicts.evidence: lines 609-630: Find rooms submits to findRooms (391-421), Try again re-runs it (616), Book room submits to book (502-544), Book another room resets and returns to the form (588-606). Every button has a working handler.

lines 400-407, 423-438: room list built only from api.findRooms; confirmation rows (549-557) come from the createBooking response. Empty result shows a 'No rooms are free' line (460). No sample or placeholder text.

lines 206-210, 476-482: a Room / When / People summary sits directly above the Book room button on the same page, and the criteria form stays visible above; status line 462-463 restates the searched time and people.

lines 320-345, 610-622: every input saves a draft to sessionStorage and loadDraft restores date, time, duration, people, title, catering and note on reload; a failed booking (530-539) clears nothing; Back from #booked shows the intact form (576-586). Room pick needs a new search after reload.

lines 157, 196, 334, 402-405: defaults are 1 hour, 2 people, next half hour, catering unticked, and the smallest fitting room preselected. No dialogs; Enter only submits the form the user is in, and the summary shows what will be booked.
lines 134-215: criteria, room choice, details and Book room are all on one page with no dialog or extra screen; two presses (Find rooms, Book room) complete a booking.
lines 137-223: sections are time and people, free rooms, meeting details (title, catering, note), a booking summary and the confirmation. Each maps to the brief; no stat cards, feeds or tips added.
line 472: Find rooms drops the primary class once rooms are shown, leaving Book room (212) as the only primary; Try again (180) is always secondary; the done view has a single button (221).
No action deletes, overwrites or is destructive; the only buttons are Find rooms, Try again, Book room and Book another room (173, 180, 212, 221).

lines 386-389: buttons get aria-disabled only while their own request runs. lines 484-493: the catering checkbox is removed for rooms without catering and text beside it says 'Catering is not offered in X. It is offered in Y.'
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
All visible strings (135-221, 368-378, 453-463, 490, 536-538, 549-556) concern dates, rooms and the booking; nothing mentions the implementation, mock data or the request.

lines 488-491: the only note is the catering line under the catering control, which affects the room choice. line 458: the stale-list line sits where the list was and tells the user to search again. No other callouts.

No text narrates the page. The only guidance is single lines at their control: 'Find rooms again to update this list' (458), 'Try another time or fewer people' (460), 'Select Book room to try again' (538).

lines 138-212: no subtitles and no helper text under labels; headings 'Time and people', 'Free rooms', 'Meeting details' have no restating description. The status line under 'Free rooms' adds count and criteria (462-463).
Headings 'Book a meeting room' (135) and 'Room booked' (218); no greeting, slogan, exclamation mark or congratulation in any string.

Labels: 'Find rooms' (173), 'Try again' (180, beside the load failure), 'Book room' (212), 'Book another room' (221); busy labels 'Finding rooms...' and 'Booking...' (471, 521). All start with a specific verb.

line 280, 303-308: feature keys are mapped to 'Screen', 'Video calls' etc; durations read '1 hour 30 min' (154-163); dates and times are locale formatted (295-301). Only server value shown raw is the id, labelled 'Booking reference' (556).

lines 455, 536, 538, 414, 368-378: 'The rooms could not be loaded.' with Try again; 'The booking was not confirmed. Select Book room to try again.'; 'That time has passed. Choose a later start time.' The raw ECONNRESET message is never shown.
Error strings (368-378, 414, 455, 510, 536, 538) contain no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals; subjects are the date, time, rooms or booking, not the user.

line 460: zero rooms shows 'No rooms are free on <when> for <n> people. Try another time or fewer people.' with the criteria form and Find rooms button directly above as the next step. No dedicated button in the empty state itself.

lines 450-464, 468-469: before a search the section is blank with its heading hidden; no match shows the 'No rooms are free' line; a failed load shows 'The rooms could not be loaded.' in error style with a Try again button.

lines 418, 455, 469: failed search shows the message in the results area with Try again, criteria kept. lines 530-539: failed booking shows a message above Book room, title, note and room selection untouched, button re-enabled (541-542).

lines 396-398, 453, 471: on search the status reads 'Finding free rooms...' and the button 'Finding rooms...' synchronously. lines 521-522: 'Booking...' and 'Booking <room>...'. Calls last at most 1.5 s, so no progress or cancel is needed.

lines 450-464: while state.search is 'loading' the only text is 'Finding free rooms...'; the empty message is reachable only in the 'done' branch after the response, and the details form is hidden (470).

lines 94, 107, 116: room grid uses minmax(0, ...) and overflow-wrap:anywhere on names and dd values; empty features show 'No equipment' (308), empty note shows 'None' (555). No path prints undefined or NaN.
lines 320-327, 610-622, 633: edits are written to sessionStorage on every input and restored by loadDraft on return or reload, so leaving the page keeps them.

lines 143-170: date, time, select and number are native typed controls with min set (170, 331), so no format has to be known before typing; title, note are free text. The only value rules (not in the past, 1 or more) are enforced by the controls or self-evident.

lines 197, 202: optional fields are marked '(optional)' in words and required ones are unmarked, but no required field carries required or aria-required (143, 148, 170, 191) although title, date, time and people are enforced (368-378, 508), so the attribute does not match.
lines 362-381, 508-512: validation runs only on submit. lines 610-612, 620: typing in a field clears its error and never sets one.

lines 144, 149, 165, 171, 192: each field has its own error paragraph directly beneath it, filled by setError (348-351); invalid fields get a 2px border plus bold text message (63-64), so not colour alone.
lines 394, 508-512, 530-539: client and server rejections only set messages; no code path clears a field on failure. Fields are cleared only by Book another room after success (589-591).

line 379: focus moves to the first invalid criteria field; 511, 534: focus moves to title; 415: to start time on a server 'past' rejection. setError sets aria-invalid (350) and inputs reference their message via aria-describedby (143, 148, 153, 170, 191).
lines 173, 212: neither submit button is ever disabled; setBusy (386-389) sets aria-disabled only during the request. Submitting incomplete input shows field messages (368-378, 510).
line 503: book() returns if state.booking is set, and the button shows 'Booking...' with aria-disabled (520-521) until finally (541-542). line 392: findRooms returns while loading.

lines 396-398, 471: Find rooms relabels to 'Finding rooms...' and status updates before the await. lines 520-522: Book room relabels to 'Booking...' at once. line 105, 623-628: choosing a room highlights it and updates the summary immediately.
lines 547-568: success swaps to a 'Room booked' view listing room, time, people, title, catering, note and reference. Failures are stated in place (455, 536, 538).
No success toast, banner or dialog exists; the confirmation view (217-223) is the result itself.

No timers dismiss anything. The load failure text and Try again stay until a new search (454-456, 469); the booking failure text stays until the user changes room or submits again (626, 522); field errors stay until the field is edited (611, 620).
No action removes, archives or moves an existing item; the flow only creates a booking.
No action permanently deletes or overwrites data, sends an unrecallable message or spends money; booking a room is a create action with its summary shown above the button (206-212).
No confirmation dialogs: no dialog element, confirm() call or overlay in the file.
No optimistic updates: the confirmation view is shown only after createBooking resolves (524-529).
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
lines 135-214: the page opens on the h1 and the time and people form, followed by the room list and details; nothing decorative precedes or outweighs them.
lines 134-139: the heading 'Book a meeting room' is followed immediately by the criteria form; no hero, greeting or intro panel.
No stat cards, summary tiles or charts; the only number is the result count inside the status sentence (462).

lines 462-463: the list is headed by '<n> rooms are free on <date, time range> for <n> people', giving count and active criteria as text; a changed criterion is flagged as stale (445, 458). The criteria are mandatory search inputs, so there is nothing to clear.

All controls are native: inputs, select, radios inside labels (426-436), checkbox, textarea and buttons in forms submitted with Enter (609, 618). Busy buttons use aria-disabled so they keep focus (387). No click-only elements; focus-visible outline at line 67.

Errors carry a text message and a thicker border as well as red (63-64); the selected room is shown by its checked radio as well as the tint (105-106); error status lines state the failure in words (455, 538).

lines 179, 211: search and booking status are role=status paragraphs present in the page from load and filled by render and setBookStatus; 199: catering note is aria-live polite. Field errors move focus to a field described by the message. Errors use status, not alert.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs; sections appear as a result of a search, not a toggle.

lines 121-128: under 600px the three-field row stacks, room cards reflow to two columns with meta and features under the name, buttons go full width and the summary list stacks. Inputs are width 100% with 44px minimum height (51-52); no fixed widths over 375px.
